position_overview:
What you'll be doing 

 What we're looking for 

 You might also have 

 Additional information
key_responsibilities:
Strategic Portfolio & Optimization: Own the prioritization, delivery, and performance of a comprehensive social portfolio. You will apply an expert-level understanding of platform algorithms and audience behaviors to optimize content for maximum reach and engagement.

Integrated Paid & Boosting Strategy: Serve as the subject matter expert for social performance, designing sophisticated paid/boosting frameworks to amplify Unity's most critical stories.

Executive Social Presence: Own the end-to-end social strategy for Unity’s executive leadership (VP+ level). You will act as a strategic consultant, shaping their digital voices to influence the industry landscape.

Cross-Functional Influence: Act as a key collaborator across business units, engaging with peers and Directors to ensure social initiatives support cross-company projects.

Operational Excellence: Identify and implement more efficient ways of achieving success, reducing complexity in our social workflows, and anticipating potential roadblocks before they impact delivery.
qualifications:
Experience: 8 -10+ years of experience in social media strategy, communications, or digital marketing, with a proven track record of managing complex portfolios for global brands.

Strategic Mastery: A practitioner who navigates with ease between ground-level execution and big-picture views, ensuring both are reflected in the final output.

Advanced Social Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of social platforms, particularly the interplay between organic content and paid growth strategies.

Autonomous Execution: A professional who delivers high-quality work based on their own judgment, requiring only occasional refinement on the most complex projects.

Team Development: A mentor-mindset with the ability to identify opportunities to further develop team capabilities and workstream dynamics.

You might also have

Content Creation Capabilities: Hands-on experience in short-form video production, design, or copywriting to help prototype or refine social-first assets.

Industry Insight: A deep understanding of the gaming, ad tech, or real-time 3D technology landscape.

Additional information

Relocation support is not available for this position

Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position
